# Getting Started

## Install And Launching R Packages

The Code Chunk Below Uses p_load() of pacman to check if tidyverse packages are installed in the computer. If they are, then they will be launched into R.

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
```

## Importing the data

```{r}
exam_data <- read_csv("data/Exam_data.csv")
```

# Plotting a simple bar chart

```{r}
#| echo: false
ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = RACE)) + 
  geom_bar()
```
